programmes.d: Oscar's young niece, Martha, arrives at the apartment in an advanced state of pregnancy and tells her uncle she has run away from home because her parents object to her decision.
Felix selects a grave site and entrusts Oscar with the money for a down payment.
Oscar becomes a somnambulist and vents his frustrations against Felix.
After their apartment is robbed, Felix talks Oscar into moving in. The new dwelling is a super-security building supervised by an over-zealous manager.
When a pregnant woman needs a helping hand, Mike is mistaken for her husband.
Bub acts as the chaperone for Robbie's costume party.
Robbie teaches American customs to a Chinese girl.
The Douglas family get an opportunity to move to Hawaii.
Alan needs Rob's help improving a script for his Broadway debut.
Rob recalls his first meeting with Alan Brady during a stay-awake marathon for his disc-jockey job.
Laura isn't happy when Rob buys himself a motorcycle.
Rob and Laura learn that buying a fur coat wholesale can be trouble when their 'connection' is Buddy Sorrell.
Uncle Joe is pelted with eggs after his team, the Hooterville Hornets lose a game.
Kate hires Herby to work as an Assistant Manager at the hotel, causing Uncle Joe to fear for his position.
Uncle Joe's latest scheme involves turning the Shady Rest into a Honeymooners getaway.
Homer Bedloe tries to gain possession of the Cannonball on Christmas Eve.
When Herby gets drafted, Kate tries to cheer him up by saying he could become an astronaut.
Bobbie Jo falls for an edgy young poet.
Opie Taylor runs away from Mayberry to join the Marines.
A bet between sergeants and Sergeant Carter's lies result in Gomer dating Miss Camp Henderson and taking her to Lookout Point.
Both Gomer and Sergeant Carter are conned by an old bum.

Sergeant Carter takes a temporary desk job writing training manuals and considers making it permanent when he sees the platoon does fine without him; so Gomer messes things up to bring the Sergeant back.

Sergeant Carter is in a restaurant with a girl other than his girlfriend when he foils an armed robbery. The Sergeant doesn't want his girlfriend to know he was there with another woman so he pins the credit on Gomer.
Gomer gets his first shot at the obstacle course.
Gomer helps a recruit smuggle his girlfriend into the barracks.

Oliver (Eddie Albert) is ready to get farming, but Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts her foot down and says she will leave unless they can hire a decorator to fix the house! Meanwhile, Kate Bradley (Bea Benaderet) teaches Lisa how to make hotcakes.

Is the Honeymoon period over already? The rumor mill has it that Lisa (Eva Gabor) has packed up and left Oliver (Eddie Albert). Actually, she went back to New York to close up their penthouse apartment. And Mr. Haney is up to his old tricks!

The cow that Oliver (Eddie Albert) bought from Mr. Haney is pregnant. Afraid that Haney will claim the new calf, Oliver and Eb decide to keep it secret...only to have the people of Hooterville think that it is Lisa (Eva Gabor) who is expecting!

Oliver (Eddie Albert) calls in a roofer, a plumber, and agricultural expert Hank Kimball (Alvy Moore). All of them give the same appraisal of his farm: it's a disaster! Meanwhile, Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) has a few chickens he'd like to rent out!

The Douglases are awaiting the arrival of their furniture and they don't know it, but Oliver's mother is on her way, too. But when the furniture is accidentally delivered to Mr. Haney's new place, he tries to sell their own possession back to them.

Planting season ends in three weeks and Oliver has yet to get his land plowed. Meanwhile, Uncle Joe (Edgar Buchanan) needs a new shotgun before duck hunting season starts and schemes to solve both of their problems...without Oliver knowing it.

When Oliver (Eddie Albert) sends a sample of his soil to the State Scientific College, a report comes back that his farm contains ingredients never before found in soil. Could his soil problems just be cosmetic? Eleanor Audley guest stars.

Relying on statistics provided by the Department of Agriculture, Oliver (Eddie Albert) decides to plant wheat. But when he goes to Drucker's to buy seed, he learns the other farmers have a unique way to predict the best crop… Mrs. Ziffel's lumbago.

After some wheeling and dealing and mending a rift between Mr. Kimball and his mother, Oliver (Eddie Albert) finally has a phone installed, but the Hooterville Phone Company installs it directly outside his bedroom window...on top of the phone pole.
Edith is arrested for passing phony $10 bills she got from Archie's Place.

After Mike and Gloria cancel their trip home for Christmas, the Bunkers decide to travel west for the holidays.
Oscar discovers he's in poor physical condition and reluctantly goes along with Felix's suggestion that he build himself up.
Hoping to get closer to his son, Felix becomes coach of the boy's football team.

After Felix induces Oscar to appear on the popular talk show Steinberg is guest-hosting, his roommate gives a riotous account of Felix's prissiness. Felix is incensed, and when Steinberg invites him to make a rebuttal, he leaps at the opportunity.
Blanche tells Oscar she is remarrying and invites him and Felix to the wedding.
Felix talks Oscar into being a big brother to Mike, a young boy in a reform school.
Oscar hires Felix to cover an international wrestling match and is thrown for a fall by subsequent developments.
Felix's grandfather, tossed out by his wife because of his insane jealousy, arrives at his grandson's apartment.
Felix invests his and Oscar's money in Mr. Wing's Japanese restaurant.
While on a nationally televised talk show, Laura accidentally reveals that Alan Brady is wearing a toupee.
Rob sets out to write a book during his vacation but has trouble getting started.
